directive.thread_id: writing-gate lane 2026-11-04: finish the launch-video port so the repository can be retired
directive.quote: Port every behaviour and every test; port the correct parts one to one and never rebuild what worked. Model ids, snapshot paths, adapter paths and hashes, the model cache root and thresholds become settings.

old_copy.deleted_with: the launch-video removal branch the lane lead pushes, in a commit that names this folder as the new home

targets.baseline_commit_message: ask-a-small-model-for-a-verdict: decider_layer.py moved byte for byte (a name redacted) as answer_with_a_downloaded_model.py

preserve: answers are cached by what answers (an adapter's BLAKE3, an MLX model at its one snapshot, a hosted model's name, or the base model), the question and the framed line with its context, so base and adapter answers never mix
an adapter's BLAKE3 is checked before it is loaded and a mismatch is refused; it is attached once to the one loaded base model with peft

an MLX model is read at its one downloaded snapshot and an ambiguous or missing snapshot is refused; its answer is the next-token softmax mass on each option word as written and capitalised, renormalised
hosted calls go through the consult-model route, one question many lines per call, bounded by line count and bytes; a line it does not answer stays None, never a guess
examples show the person's ruled lines of a set first, never the judged line nor a line that contains it or that it contains
a line's film context is shown right before it in a fixed order and is part of the cache key
calibrate scores each line by its worst sentence, counts only the split asked for and, when asked, only lines with context, and passes the scores to this folder's fit-lines with the person's bars
the device is what the computer reports, else cuda, then mps, then cpu; no home folder is guessed for the hosted route
allowed_deltas: every model id, snapshot, adapter folder, the model cache root, the answer cache, the frame, the batch sizes, the good sets, the example sources and the fit bars come from the person's setting row (list:settings, read through tools/settings) instead of constants and environment variables; the environment variables stay as the place's fallback
an adapter may be named by name, its folder the setting's adapters[name], beside the old {path, blake3}
a stand-in model (ask.model.stand_in) answers from the ask itself and is never cached, so a sample run and a test answer without a model

the labelled lines an ask's examples name, and the lines calibrate reads, are given in the request (read from the person's Checks list) instead of files under the copy gate; an old path names its set by the file's stem
one JSON request in and { result } or { error } on the last line, instead of argv flags, a bare JSON answer and SystemExit
fit-lines is called beside this file instead of through TRILLION_WORKSHOP
the hosted prompt, its reply table, the MLX prompt and the adapter folder are their own functions so tests reach them
banned_substitutions: a model id, snapshot, adapter folder or threshold written into the code
a second copy of the fit (t_fail, t_pass, AUC, recall, held-out shares)
a guess in place of a missing model answer
_paths: The source lives in a private repository, so it is named by the BLAKE3 identity of its path (path_multihash); a checkout of that repository beside this one finds it. The redactions replace a person's name in two steps so no literal here holds it.
